The ultimate culmination of the War of Two Crowns, and the final battle. 

### OVERALL PLOT:
This is a big thing. First is the big war battle at the base of/ slightly up the mountain. Then the party will split off from the battle and do the Monolith dungeon. The war battle will feature the final fight between Ivar/ Arkonil, Augustus, and Adrithyr.

During the war battle, Arkonil phase activates, Augustus arrives, Adrithyr arrives, Cassandra arrives. They will defeat Arkonil (chance to allow him to kill Adrithyr), and Augustus and Cassandra will race to the body, and attempt to activate some ancient magic. (Party can fight Augustus to try and stop them), when the ritual completes in front of the sun will begin to shine a glowing white clock face (they believe this ritual would mantle Cassandra back into divinity), but nothing happens, and Cassandra begins to wither, Ivys hears Kairos laughing, "I know that little lie would sate her endless desire for divinity. Now I have everything I need." Cassandra dies, Augustus' light fades as Shao Daraan abandons him. Melantha now carries the light. "Her story was over... and so is this chapter of mine."

They leave and head for the fortress told by Augustus, "The last thing I saw with my gift, you need to get up there, and you need to do it alone. Quickly, you're almost out of time."

They will reach the top, and during the battle Aldred will activate the Monolith, which will bridge the gap between the Monolith, the Abyss, and the Oakenheart. 
Marrow will head to the Abyss to destroy it, hoping to free Balthazaar, while Aldred heads towards the Oakenheart. 

The party will be heavily weakened by the fight, and be forced to bargain with Kairos, who will offer the party enough time to long rest, in exchange for convincing Clovis to set him free from the Endless Void. They will agree, because Ivys will know there is no other possible way they can win.

When Kairos is set free the party will have enough strength to defeat Aldred and Marrow, meaning a victory... or does it?

As you stand triumphant, your party reuniting at the Monolith with your allies, the sun shines through the now breaking clouds of darkness, but it appears to be moving, quicker than it should. The sun begins to speed up as it and the moons fly through the sky, the day of a thousand dawns. 

Kairos speaks behind them laughing quietly, "You all have no idea how much dedication and time it took to ingrain that Day of a Thousand Dawns facade into the timeline, but it appears it was well worth it. Come, turn and face your World Ender."
